title: DEEPKNOWN-GUARD: A PROPRIETARY MODEL-BASED SAFETY RESPONSE FRAMEWORK FOR AI AGENTS

bias_targets.methodology: The paper evaluates bias as part of a broader general safety and risk assessment. Models are tested on their ability to classify and safely respond to adversarial or risky queries (which explicitly include implicit bias and severe discrimination) using general safety evaluation datasets like S-Eval and a proprietary high-risk dataset. Performance is measured using aggregate Safety Scores and Risk Recall Rates rather than isolated bias metrics.
